SELECT SUM(ym."Consumption") AS total_consumption
FROM main."yearmonth" ym
JOIN main."customers" c ON ym."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
WHERE c."Segment" = 'SME'
  AND ym."Date" = '201306'
